meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把需求变成一份可直接动工的实施方案,动手前理清步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在动手写代码前,想先拿出一份清晰的实施计划。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a rough request into one decision-complete plan before you start coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear work plan nailed down before writing any code.

howto.what: 它会先只读地探索你的代码和资料,再把需求写成一份可直接执行的计划,存到 .omo/ 下;末尾还要过一遍结构自检。全程不改产品代码、不派实施者,直到你明确同意,而同意也只授权写计划。
howto.when: 当你明确要求 ulw-plan 工作流,或要求在动手前先出一份计划时接管。单独的 ulw 运行不会自动触发它。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 给登录接口加限流做一份计划
say.note: 先探索再出计划,不碰代码

say.text: 先别动手,把支付模块重构的计划写出来
say.note: 进入规划模式,计划等你确认后再写

say.text: 这份计划要做高精度审查
say.note: 计划需经 plan-reviewer 审查后才交付

howto.what_en: It explores your code read-only first, then writes one decision-complete work plan under .omo/, plus a structural self-check. It never edits product code or dispatches implementers until you say okay, and approval only authorizes writing the plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly request the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation. A bare ulw run never activates it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to write a plan for adding rate limiting to the login endpoint
say_en.note: Explores first, then writes the plan; no code edits

say_en.text: Don't code yet - write the plan for refactoring the payments module
say_en.note: Enters plan mode; plan waits for your okay
Plan runs through a plan-reviewer before handoff
